quotes.text: 1a. ¿En la semana pasada, trabajó por lo menos una hora? (sin contar las tareas de su hogar)
... no podía trabajar por razones personales? (cuidado del hogar, estudios, incapacidad) 2
1. ¿Quién realiza la mayor parte de las tareas de la casa?
2. ¿Qué otras personas ayudan en las tareas de la casa?

assessments.reasoning: The survey explicitly excludes household tasks from the definition of work in question 1a of the Individual Questionnaire ("sin contar las tareas de su hogar"). Domestic tasks are mentioned as a reason for not working/inactivity in question 1e ("cuidado del hogar"). Although Block VII of the Household Questionnaire asks who performs most tasks and who helps, these questions are asked once for the household as a whole rather than recording domestic work separately for each person through individual-level questions. Therefore, the instrument does not record domestic work for each person through dedicated individual questions.
